Read the CAMELS-PE Soil Legend

Source: R/soil.R
read_soil_legend.Rd

Reads the soil legend of CAMELS-PE, which lists the soil suborders and great groups present in the catchments, with the order and suborder they belong to (USDA Soil Taxonomy, as in the DSOLMap legend), and the 12 USDA texture classes.

read_soil_legend(path = get_camels_path())

Arguments

path

Character string. Optional path to the CAMELS-PE root directory. If not provided, the path previously defined with set_camels_path() is used.

Value

A tibble with the columns level ("suborder", "great_group" or "texture"), class (code used in soil_classes.csv and in the soil attributes), name, order and suborder.

Examples

path <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "sample_camels_pe",
  package = "RCamelsPE"
)

read_soil_legend(path = path)
#> # A tibble: 53 × 5
#>    level    class     name      order       suborder
#>    <chr>    <chr>     <chr>     <chr>       <chr>   
#>  1 suborder udalfs    Udalfs    Alfisols    NA      
#>  2 suborder ustalfs   Ustalfs   Alfisols    NA      
#>  3 suborder xeralfs   Xeralfs   Alfisols    NA      
#>  4 suborder argids    Argids    Aridisols   NA      
#>  5 suborder fluvents  Fluvents  Entisols    NA      
#>  6 suborder orthents  Orthents  Entisols    NA      
#>  7 suborder psamments Psamments Entisols    NA      
#>  8 suborder orthels   Orthels   Gelisols    NA      
#>  9 suborder aquepts   Aquepts   Inceptisols NA      
#> 10 suborder ochrepts  Ochrepts  Inceptisols NA      
#> # ℹ 43 more rows
